mapper.sql: select p.purchase_id, p.purchase_no, p.store_id, p.supplier, p.status, p.item_count, p.total_qty, p.total_amount, p.expect_time, p.inbound_time, p.inbound_by, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, s.store_name from pet_purchase p left join pet_store s on s.store_id = p.store_id
mapper.select: select item_id, purchase_id, purchase_no, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, spec, cost_price, qty, amount, stock_before, create_time from pet_purchase_item where purchase_no = #{purchaseNo} order by item_id asc

select item_id, purchase_id, purchase_no, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, spec, cost_price, qty, amount, stock_before, create_time from pet_purchase_item where purchase_id in #{id} order by item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into pet_purchase (purchase_no, store_id, supplier, status, item_count, total_qty, total_amount, expect_time, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{purchaseNo}, #{storeId}, #{supplier}, #{status}, #{itemCount}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{expectTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())

insert into pet_purchase_item (purchase_id, purchase_no, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, spec, cost_price, qty, amount, create_time) values (#{purchaseId}, #{purchaseNo}, #{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImage}, #{spec}, #{costPrice}, #{qty}, #{amount}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pet_purchase_item set stock_before = #{stockBefore} where item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select:
select ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' and date(inbound_time) = #{date} then total_amount else 0 end), 0) as inboundAmount, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as inboundCount, ifnull((select count(*) from pet_goods g where g.del_flag = '0' and g.status = '0' and g.stock <= 10), 0) as lowStock from pet_purchase
store_id = #{storeId}
